protocol.note: Directional comparison on the 200-episode search/validation library (seed 20264010), not the 500-episode official library (20265010). Heuristic reference re-run on the same library to obtain occupancy. Paired rescued/harmed computed via paired_episode_id against the heuristic reference (rescued = REIM success & heuristic failure).

comparisons.caveat: No reachable operating point matches the heuristic occupancy at this noise level: even the professor-suggested 0.02/3 setting (supplementary run) reaches only 0.393 occupancy (< 0.482). However that run already matches/beats heuristic success (0.480 vs 0.470, rescued 27 vs harmed 25) while using ~9pp lower occupancy budget, i.e. REIM achieves parity at strictly lower budget at noise 0.1.
